owner_and_capability: Timetable & Activities — slice S1 of #3424 (#3554): the instance lifecycle (start, completion, reopen, cancellation with its guardian notice, delete, create, planned edit, re-plan), the staff move, the standalone understaffed acknowledgement, the series conversion and the scheduler's automatic start and end leave modules/timetable/legacy/timetableplanning and become the public contracts timetable.InstanceLifecycle, timetable.InstancePlanning, timetable.InstanceStaffing, timetable.InstanceSeriesConversion, timetable.InstanceAutoStart and timetable.InstanceAutoEnd, implemented in modules/timetable/compose; the nest and modules/timetable/legacy/timetablesqltest are deleted
atomic_cutover: One PR moves the lifecycle to the owner, switches api/timetable, api/students, the group live view, the scheduler and the composition root to the public contract, deletes the nest and the SQL test providers and retires the thirteen #2732 keys the facade leaked. api/timetable receives owner types (timetable.LifecycleInstance and the lifecycle inputs, results and sentinels) instead of models/schedule rows, reads the vocabulary it borrowed from models/activities, models/schedule and internal/schoolclass from the public contract (pinned against the models), matches owner sentinels instead of models/base error helpers, uses sharedkernel/calendar instead of internal/timezone and announces staffing changes through a consumer-owned port instead of the realtime hub. Its tests build fixtures through the bound repositories and the owner contract. HTTP paths, status codes, error texts, payloads, permissions and tenant scoping stay the same. No second provider, no fallback and no new debt key is added.
tests: modules/timetable/compose and modules/timetable/compose/httpintegration: the lifecycle, auto-start, auto-end, series-conversion, guardian-notice, staff-move, re-plan, session-end and deviation-log suites ported from the nest, against the isolated PostgreSQL test database.

api/timetable: the instance, operations, deviation, template and conversion route and contract tests on the owner contract, plus the vocabulary pins and rule parity tests in modules/timetable/compose.
modules/workforce and workflows/shiftplansync suites on Workforce and Timetable owner types.
go test ./test/ -run 'Ratchet|TestHermeticTestPatterns', go test ./internal/architecture/ and scripts/test-changed.sh without --fast.
scripts/backend-architecture.sh check with exactly these thirteen keys absent from legacy.jsonl and none added.
